items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against advance tax payment assessment
items.quote:
Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe
Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Posting ('Aufgabe zur Post') was Saturday 21.11.2026. Under the statutory rule of § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, a letter sent by ordinary post is deemed delivered on the third day after posting (not the fourth day as the letter itself claims - see warning). 21.11.2026 + 3 days = 24.11.2026 (Tuesday), which is not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday, so the fictitious notification date (Bekanntgabe) is 24.11.2026. The one-month Einspruchsfrist then runs under §108 Abs. 1 AO i.V.m. §§187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe itself is not counted, the period begins the next day (25.11.2026), and ends one month later on the day bearing the same date-number as the Bekanntgabe day, i.e. 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or statutory holiday in NRW (Christmas Eve is not itself a public holiday), so no shift applies. Final deadline: 24.12.2026.

items.quote:

items.computation: Due date printed as 10.03. for calendar year 2027 (first quarter after 'ab 2027'). 10.03.2027 falls on a Wednesday, which is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no shift under §108 Abs. 3 AO is needed.

items.title: Q2 2027 advance income tax payment
items.computation: Due date printed as 10.06.2027. This date falls on a Thursday and is not Fronleichnam (which in 2027 falls on 27.05.2027, i.e. Easter Sunday 28.03.2027 + 60 days) nor any other NRW public holiday, so no shift is needed.

items.title: Q3 2027 advance income tax payment
items.computation: Due date printed as 10.09.2027. This date falls on a Friday and is not a public holiday in NRW, so no shift is needed.

items.computation: Due date printed as 10.12.2027. This date falls on a Friday and is not a public holiday in NRW, so no shift is needed.

warnings: The letter states that notification occurs 'am vierten Tag nach der ... Aufgabe zur Post' (the fourth day after posting), but the statutory rule under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO is the THIRD day after posting; I used the legally correct third-day rule to compute the Einspruch deadline (24.12.2026) - if the Finanzamt actually applies its own stated 'fourth day' rule the apparent deadline would be one day later (25.12.2026, a public holiday, shifting to 28.12.2026). Please confirm the actual postmark/delivery date with the Finanzamt if in doubt.
The letter indicates the 'Aufgabe zur Post' (handover to the postal service) occurred on a Saturday (21.11.2026), which is unusual for an authority but has been taken as stated in the letter.
